title: Weighted sum over labeled subsets
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $w$ assign a real number to each subset of the coordinate set of size $k$ (viewed as a function on all subsets). Sum $w(S)$ over all pairs consisting of such a subset $S$ and a bijection from a $k$-element set onto $S$. This sum equals $k!$ times the sum of $w(S)$ over all subsets $S$ of size $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the subsets of the coordinate set
